title: Law to publicize 9/11 victim benefit programs
summary: This bill would require the Health Department to run public education campaigns about programs that help, monitor or compensate people harmed by the September 11, 2001 attacks, including the World Trade Center Health Registry and Health Program and the September 11th Victim Compensation Fund. It would also require the department to create an opt-in email and text notification system to alert registered individuals about eligibility requirements and deadlines. Materials and notifications must be available in English and designated citywide languages, and the law would take effect 30 days after enactment.
